response.justification: The candidate is a strong individual-contributor engineer with broad full-stack, systems, and embedded experience, but has no demonstrated executive leadership track record, no evidence of scaling teams from 10 to 30+, no fintech-domain depth beyond a brief pricing-engineering role, and no production multi-agent AI system ownership — only recent, vague 'contributions' to AI-agent tooling. This profile matches a senior/staff engineer, not a CTO for an agentic-AI fintech scale-up.
strengths: Broad technical range across web, embedded, mobile and backend systems
Some recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP tooling) at re:cinq
Prior fintech-adjacent experience at RIDE Capital and Optilyz
concerns: No evidence of engineering leadership or team-scaling (never managed or grew a team)
No production multi-agent AI system architecture or ownership at scale
No experience with regulated financial systems, credit risk, or compliance infrastructure at an executive level

key_factors.factor: No production multi-agent AI system experience
